system.sourceMarkdown:
# Grave Wisp (CV 7)

*A pale drifting light with the faint suggestion of a face deep inside it. The wisp is a dead person’s lingering need for a witness, not a source of useful flame.*

**HP:** 6 · **Speed:** Ground 0; fly 6 · **Footprint:** 1x1

**Summoned form — player reference.**

**Defense modifier:** 1 Boon. · **Stability:** 0.

**DR / resistance:** None · **Condition immunities:** Bleeding; Poisoned; Asleep

**Weakness:** None

**Healing:** Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body. Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

**Against offensive healing:** controller defends with Fortitude if this is player-controlled; a player attacking it still rolls only their attack.


**Senses:** Dark sight 6 squares.

**Communication:** None

**Attributes:** Brawn -2; Fortitude +0; Agility +2; Guile +1; Knowledge +0; Reason +1

**Eligibility:** Undead 1

Main command: Main + Maneuver; Maneuver command: Maneuver + movement. One command per summon per controller turn; immediate summoning command counts. No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or controller unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot.

**Carrying:** up to 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No granted crafting training.

Roll its printed attack attribute and read the attacker outcomes below. When it is attacked, roll the defense attribute named by the incoming attack. Passive defenses remain; no independent active effects.

**Lifeless Body — Passive:** does not breathe or eat; only listed immunities apply.

## Attacks — Main Action

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cold spark | Reason | None | 1 cold damage. | 2 cold damage. | 3 cold damage. |


**Cold spark:** One visible creature within 3 squares.

## Maneuvers

### Guide the Light — Maneuver

*A ribbon of lanternlight runs along the path, picking out each stone on the way to shelter.*

Brightly light up to 3 connected squares within 3 squares until the start of the controller’s next turn. Requires an unobstructed path from this creature to each square; it may choose unlit squares. Ordinary darkness imposes no Boons or Banes for seeing those squares; cover, concealment and hiding still use the normal rules. This neither reveals Hidden creatures automatically nor penetrates opaque obstacles. Reusing this ability replaces its previous illuminated area.

Use only as part of a command; no independent activity.

**Defend — Maneuver:** gain 1 Boon to defenses until the start of the controller’s next turn; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Basic Melee — Main:** None to attack; Brawn, one adjacent target; Weak attack 1, Standard 2, Strong 4 physical damage. No specialty riders. No opportunity Reaction.

[DA creature card](../creatures/grave-wisp.md) · [Summon rules](../../rules/summoning.md)
